scope: remote exact source-candidate fresh-deployment and provider restart continuity review of retained records; no new deployment or restart

G5.08.claim: The recorded fresh source-runtime deployment and subsequent provider process/container restart preserve state.
G5.08.basis: The fresh canonical source deployment compares the complete 2163-account backup bank with its held finalized snapshot. All user/programme accounts and application tables/files match; only named protocol data and exactly reconciled validator vote-fee movement differ. That deployment runtime exactly matches the restart-before identity, and the restart-after runtime matches the final freeze. The restart preserves its full sampled state snapshot.
G5.08.scopeLimit: Fresh deployment means the actual reviewed source-runtime migration onto the existing volume. Restart coverage is a provider process/container restart; hardware-host reboot is outside operator control. This does not authorize another deployment or certify arbitrary future images.

supersedes.resolution: Fresh deployment evidence is now individually linked to the exact final candidate through the selected restart record. Other partial requirements in that review remain open.

limitations: The source-runtime image differs from the earlier probe image; the recorded source-file and executable review supports this image, not reproducible OCI image bytes.
This review checks retained report equality, identity linkage, table hashes and vote-fee arithmetic. It does not independently re-enumerate current accounts or replay a ledger.
Deployment continuity uses the complete recorded bank/application comparison; subsequent restart continuity uses its recorded sample, not a second complete inventory.
The old archive does not contain later workload/browser activity. Monitoring delivery and production/preview environment separation remain unreviewed.
